PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # inverter NMOS gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion for gm)
    "Ln":     (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # inverter PMOS gm/Id (sets Vsg -> Vin/Vout DC)
    "Lp":     (0.35, 0.15, 0.8),
    "Icore":  (24e-6, 12e-6, 26e-6),  # inverter / tail current
    "Rf":     (2.7e5, 2.6e5, 3.2e5),  # feedback resistor (sets Zt, noise)
    "gmid_t": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # tail / reference mirror
    "Lt":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["Icore"]; Rf = p["Rf"]; Cx = 50e-12
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # ---- self-consistent DC: PMOS sets Vin=Vout, NMOS source node vx = Vin - Vgs_n
    vin, vx = 0.8, 0.3
    for _ in range(4):
        mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=max(VDD - vin, 0.3))
        vin = VDD - mp.vgs
        mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=max(vin - vx, 0.1), vsb=max(vx, 0.0))
        vx = vin - mn.vgs
    vx_eff = max(vx, 0.12)

    # ---- tail mirror (same L, gm/Id; Id scaled)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.5)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["Lt"], I, vds=0.5)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "x", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MN", "vout", "iin", "x", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "iin", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("CX", "x", "vss", Cx)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)

    # ---- small-signal model (3 nodes: vi, vo, vx)
    gmn, gmp = mn.gm, mp.gm
    gmbs = getattr(mn, "gmbs", 0.0)
    gdsn, gdsp, gdst = mn.gds, mp.gds, mt.gds
    Cf = mn.cgd + mp.cgd
    Cin = cpd + (mn.cgg - mn.cgd) + (mp.cgg - mp.cgd)
    Co = cl + max(mn.cdd - mn.cgd, 0) + max(mp.cdd - mp.cgd, 0)

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        Y = np.array([
            [s * Cin + Yf, -Yf, 0.0],
            [-Yf + gmp + gmn, Yf + s * Co + gdsp + gdsn, -(gmn + gmbs + gdsn)],
            [-gmn, -gdsn, gmn + gmbs + gdsn + gdst + s * Cx]], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        return abs(v[1])

    fr = np.logspace(3, 10, 3000)
    z = np.array([zt(f) for f in fr])
    z0 = z[0]
    idx = np.where(z < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    if len(idx) and idx[0] > 0:
        i = idx[0]
        f3 = 10 ** np.interp(math.log10(z0 / math.sqrt(2)),
                             [math.log10(z[i]), math.log10(z[i - 1])],
                             [math.log10(fr[i]), math.log10(fr[i - 1])])
    else:
        f3 = fr[-1]

    # ---- noise at 1 MHz (input-referred)
    en2 = kT4 * 0.7 / (gmn + gmp)
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + en2 * ((w * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2 + (1.0 / Rf) ** 2) + kT4 * 0.7 * gdst * 0
    pred = {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": VDD * (iref + I),
        "vout_dc": vin,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
    }
    return n, pred
